title: Who Gets Seen in the Age of AI? Adoption Patterns of Large Language Models in Scholarly Writing and Citation Outcomes

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing citation counts, journal tier placement, and citation network metrics (such as PageRank and regional assortativity) between authors in the Global West and Global East to assess disparities in scholarly visibility and the impact of ChatGPT adoption on these disparities.

Regressing 'humanness' scores (calculated via the Binoculars zero-shot detection tool) against citation outcomes to evaluate whether 'human-like' writing styles (versus AI-assisted styles) incur citation penalties, and determining if AI tools act as linguistic equalizers for non-Anglophone authors.
